system.longDesc: You work with the raw stuff of magic itself, sensing and controlling arcane power.
system.requirement: Power talent: Intelligence (Power Arcana) power focus at Expert

degree0.desc: You gain two Novice-degree Power Arcana spells.

degree1.desc: You gain one Expert-degree Power Arcana spell. You also gain the power focus Intelligence (Power Arcana).

degree2.desc: You gain one Master-degree Power Arcana spell. You can also choose one power stunt you can perform with your Power Arcana spells for –1 SP.
